title: Figure 9: human fields of view around a cockpit seat (normal, eye-scanning, macula)
description: Graphic of a wireframe cockpit seat and panels inside a sphere overlaid with nested red-shaded zones labelled "Normal field of view," "Area of easy eye motion scanning" and "Area where details can be discerned (Macula)." A corner insert divides a display into quadrants showing eye-fixation percentages (47%, 20%, 20%, 13%), with the upper-right highest. Captioned "Figure 9. Human Fields of View. [Graphic: A. Szames]," accompanying text on ±100°, ±60°, ±6° and ±2° visual ranges.
